title: Three Springs and One Short Rope
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物与植物）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物与植物）　|　核心词汇：goat　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 goat 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the farmer ① bought a goat that no neighbour in the valley would have described, and he said the buying was the whole of the spring. The ② goat, meaning the animal itself and not the sheep, ran three springs and stayed undescribed in the book; a goat, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ goat in that valley had the same short rope beside it, and the ④ goat at the far shed, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A goat, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the farmer said the describing is the part that fills three springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the goat was the whole of the matter, meaning the milk and not the animal. The ⑥ goat, meaning the milk and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; goat, he said, is either something you buy or the only word that means both an animal and a milk. He said the milk is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ goat had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short rope. The ⑧ goat of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in November, was one valley and three springs of describing; goat, he said, is either the one at the far shed or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ goat I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1974 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ goat, my mother said in 1976, is the only one that improves by being described; every goat, she said, is a milk that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the milk was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 山羊（指山谷里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 山羊（指那只动物本身，与绵羊相对）
C. 固定搭配：buy a goat 买一只山羊
D. n. 山羊（指留给孩子们照看的那一只）
E. n. 山羊（抽象总称，指一处山谷的山羊之事）
F. n. 山羊（指计划里写到、被记录过的那一只）
G. n. 羊奶（指一件事里人人都喝却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 羊奶（抽象总称，指人人都喝却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bought a goat that no neighbour in the valley would have described
The goat, meaning the animal itself and not the sheep
the goat at the far shed
the goat was the whole of the matter

The goat of the whole thing

answers.why: buy a goat 意为“买一只山羊”，1967 年那位农夫买了山谷里没有一位邻居肯描述的一只山羊。
goat 意为“山羊”，指那只动物本身而不是绵羊，它经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被描述。
goat 意为“山羊”，指山谷里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一根矮矮的绳子。
goat 意为“山羊”，指最远那间棚里留给孩子们照看的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
goat 意为“羊奶”，指一件事里人人都喝却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份羊奶就是那件事的全部。
goat 意为“羊奶”，指人人都喝却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只山羊，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
goat 意为“山羊”，指计划里写到、被记录过的那一只，到 1972 年这一只成了计划里的一行。
goat 意为“山羊”，农夫十一月写道，整件事的山羊之事是一处山谷和三个春天的描述。
goat 意为“山羊”，我记得的是计划里描述过的那一只，1974 年卖掉了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一只。
goat 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，一只山羊是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
